Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: high-end art direction target image for an existing landscape mobile 3D kart racing game, one wide 16:9 image, 2560x1440 if possible.
Create a beautiful cohesive premium stylized 3D seaside kart racing environment, as an achievable polished game art target. This is a full gameplay environment composition, not a poster or collage. Player's elevated third-person chase camera about 4 metres high and 8 metres behind a compact orange-and-ivory open-wheel racing kart with one orange-helmeted driver; see rear and right quarter of kart, centered lower middle at modest game scale, occupying about 18 percent of image width. Exactly four chunky black tires, clear ivory central racing stripe, dark visor, brushed metal hubs, glossy enamel body shell, visible rear bumper, a tasteful small exhaust and rear mechanical details. Original design, no franchise characters, no logos.
Track: readable broad gently curving coastal asphalt road sweeping right into the middle distance, charcoal blue fine-grained asphalt, ivory edge lines, red and ivory low kerbs, a few subtle tire scuffs, accurately solid barriers with beveled red and cream modular sections. Show a little warm sand and short lush grass between road and coast. Tiny opposing racers farther ahead only.
Environment: two elegant coconut palms with broad sculpted green fronds in near-mid ground; rounded broadleaf seaside trees with several organic interlocking crowns farther inland; layered pale sandstone coastal boulders with grass tufts; vivid shallow turquoise water fading into cobalt bay; a distant compact ivory cylindrical lighthouse with coral cap and teal trim on a rocky islet, small marina sails; one tasteful cream/coral race pavilion far to the side. A few triangular pennant flags, track chevrons and warm yellow route lights, composed carefully so gameplay road stays uncluttered. White puffy summer clouds, soft blue atmospheric depth, beautiful late-afternoon sunlight, soft contact shadows and warm bounce light, clean and fresh, neither glaring nor washed out.
Art style: sophisticated stylized 3D game art, soft bevels and intentional geometry, subtle physically based material variation, toy-like proportions but believable materials. Rich well-composed tropical scenery, elegant complementary orange/teal color design. Crisp kart and road details; no excessive bloom, no lens flares, no giant speed trails. Landscape view fills the entire canvas, no UI, no text, no title, no watermark, no panels, no diagram. Make the whole scene cohesive and polished, with the track strongly legible. The image is a target concept, not an existing gameplay screenshot.
